pages.text: The $(item)Large Engine$() and the cheaper $(item)Simple Large Engine$() work like a Create steam engine: they drive a $(item)Powered Shaft 2 blocks in front$() of them. Placed on the floor, the shaft goes 2 blocks above; on a wall, 2 blocks out from it.
Right-click the engine with a $(item)Shaft$() to put it in the right spot. The shaft must cross the engine's direction, not point at it.

$(l)What they need$()$(li)$(item)Fuel$(): diesel, kerosene, naphtha or furnace gas (2000 mB tank).$(li)$(item)Air$() in a separate 1000 mB air tank. Pipe it from an $(item)Air Intake$().$(li)Room in the 2000 mB $(item)exhaust$() tank: pump the CO2 away.

No redstone, no components: once fuel, air and shaft are there, it runs. The shaft turns at $(item)128 RPM$(). Every 2 seconds the engine uses 150 mB of air and 3 mB of fuel; the simple large engine burns $(item)12 mB$(), four times more.
